text:
Inez (CS): Drafting a tiny 'kickoff safety net' AMs can paste into trial kickoff notes. Needs to cover prefill, warm pool, quick telemetry checks, and a feedback ask.
Kofi (Solutions): one-line prefill + 3 yes/no checks would be perfect.
Inez (CS): Pasteable checklist (3 mins):
Inez (CS): - Run idempotent prefill (templates + last_20 messages).
Inez (CS): - Reserve warm pool: 2 sessions for first 12h.
Inez (CS): - Enable streaming fallback + client retry (3x w/ jitter).
Dina (SRE): Ops bits: set autoscale min=2 for 12h, then min=0. Healthcheck: GET /healthz after pool creation. Track prefill_fail metric per tenant.
Kofi (Solutions): One-line prefill (pasteable):
Kofi (Solutions): ```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"TRIAL_SAFE","idempotency_key":"kickoff-$(date +%s)","items":[{"type":"template","name":"starter"},{"type":"history","last_n":20}]}'
```
Marco (PM): Renewal signal: day7 pulse => if active_queries_day7 < 0.4 * avg(day1-3) OR p99_latency > 1.2s then flag for enablement outreach.
Dina (SRE): Alert thresholds: 5xx_rate > 0.5% OR streaming_error_rate > 1% OR p99_stream_latency > 1200ms -> route to #oncall-infra and tag AM.
Inez (CS): Customer blurb to paste: "We ran a light prefill and reserved capacity for the first day to speed up your first replies. Reply if you'd rather we not run this."
Inez (CS): Small AM checklist to paste in notes: Prefill_done? (yes/no); Warm_pool_active? (yes/no); Eval_prompts_collected? (yes/no); Feedback_link_sent? (yes/no)
Dina (SRE): Demo tip: ask silence-bot to mute deploy alerts for short demos: `silence-bot mute deploys 30m tenant:TRIAL_SAFE`
silence-bot: OK — deploy alerts muted for 30 minutes for tenant:TRIAL_SAFE :white_check_mark:
Kofi (Solutions): I'll add this 1-pager + curl to the CS template library and include the customer blurb.
Inez (CS): Thanks — I'll link it into the renewal playbook as the "kickoff safety net" touchpoint.
